'''2007 Texas State Championship Matthew Ortiz LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Ortiz]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hidden Base
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
